# Playerstack

> Embeddable video player for any HTML page. Drop one script tag, embed YouTube, Vimeo, MP4, or HLS with branding and CTAs. MIT, plugin-first.

## What it is
Playerstack is a thin layer on top of Mux's media-chrome and media-elements with a marketing layer added: branded thumbnails, click-to-load (LCP + GDPR), end-of-video CTAs, autopreview, themed controls. Framework-agnostic Web Component.

## Quickstart
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/playerstack@0.1.0/dist/playerstack.min.js" defer></script>
<player-stack src="https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ"></player-stack>
```

## Plugins (all 16 ship in the standalone bundle, all MIT)
- `@playerstack/plugin-sources` — auto-detects YouTube, Vimeo, MP4, HLS, WebM, DASH
- `@playerstack/plugin-controls-policy` — theme color, show/hide controls
- `@playerstack/plugin-autopreview` — muted autoplay in viewport, respects prefers-reduced-motion
- `@playerstack/plugin-branded-thumb` — custom poster, click-to-load (no third-party cookies until click)
- `@playerstack/plugin-cta-end` — overlay HTML at end of video, button with UTM, replay
- `@playerstack/plugin-chapters` — clickable timecoded navigation
- `@playerstack/plugin-action-bar` — mid-video dismissible CTA banner
- `@playerstack/plugin-email-gate` — pause-and-collect lead capture
- `@playerstack/plugin-saved-position` — resume watching
- `@playerstack/plugin-sticky` — corner-pin on scroll
- `@playerstack/plugin-focus-mode` — auto-pause on tab blur
- `@playerstack/plugin-analytics` — beacon / gtag forwarder
- `@playerstack/plugin-yt-subscribe` — subscribe-on-YouTube bar
- `@playerstack/plugin-watermark` — corner-pinned logo/text overlay
- `@playerstack/plugin-custom-css` — arbitrary scoped CSS injection (Presto Pro parity)
- `@playerstack/plugin-intro-card` — pre-roll marketing splash (title, subtitle, badge, CTA, big play button)

## Stack
Bun monorepo. TypeScript strict. Engine: Mux media-chrome + media-elements (MIT). esbuild bundler. Astro docs site.

## License
MIT for core and all 16 plugins. Premium plugins (post-MVP) are proprietary.
